findings.summary: The fp32 upcast happens after original_sd = model.state_dict() is captured (line 649), so with cpu_ram_efficient_loading and mixed precision rank 0 broadcasts bf16/fp16 tensors while other ranks allocate fp32 buffers, risking garbage weights, NCCL errors or hangs.

judge.reason: Describes the same defect: the upcast happens after original_sd is captured, so rank 0 broadcasts bf16 while other ranks allocate fp32.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Any Params4bit in the model causes the upcast to be skipped for the whole model, so QLoRA models with bf16 adapters and fp32 norms keep mixed dtypes, a regression from the old code that upcast regardless.

judge.reason: This is a different complaint (the Params4bit skip causing mixed dtypes). I can't confirm from the given information that it is a real defect.
